name: Carrd
whatYouLose: A mature visual editor with years of edge-case handling
Managed custom domains and DNS assistance
A large library of polished templates and widgets
prompt: Build a single-page website generator for founders. Provide ten section types, editable copy and colors, responsive previews, image uploads, contact forms, SEO fields, custom domains configuration instructions, page publishing, version history and HTML export. Use Astro SSR for the dashboard and generated sites, vanilla JavaScript for editing interactions, and SQLite for projects. Prioritize excellent defaults over a complex free-form canvas.
notes: You can replace the outcome, not Carrd’s refined editor. Opinionated blocks are faster to build and often produce better pages.
